items: 2 tsp powdered sugar, sifted on top

steps.title: Mix the crust
steps.body: Cut together **2 cups flour**, **1 cup butter** and **½ cup powdered sugar**. Pat into an ungreased 10×12 pan.

steps.title: Mix the filling
steps.body: In separate bowl, add together **4 beaten eggs**, **2 cups sugar**, **4 Tbsp flour**, **6 Tbsp lemon juice** and grated lemon rind.

steps.title: Add the filling
steps.body: Pour over the hot crust, and bake for an additional 20–25 minutes.

steps.title: Sift the sugar
steps.body: **Sift 2 tsp powdered sugar** after removing the pan from the oven.
